Bug_Title: Virtual threads should not run tasks that include synchronized code
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates the bug by starting virtual threads that execute tasks containing synchronized code. This causes the virtual thread to be pinned to an OS thread, which prevents the JVM from optimizing its usage during blocking operations.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case calls the method showBug() of VirtualThreadBugExample class. This method internally invokes enqueueWithSynchronizedBlock() and enqueueWithSynchronizedMethod(), both of which start virtual threads that enter synchronized blocks or call synchronized methods, violating the rule that virtual threads should not run tasks that include synchronized code. This pins the virtual thread to an OS thread, leading to potential scalability issues, thereby triggering the bug.
